subject: Install resident coordination daemon and close inbox-consumption gap
body: Install the LaunchAgent-backed resident coordination loop. This is the control-plane fix: heartbeat must not remain healthy while coordination inbox waits unconsumed. The daemon pulls repo state every 15 seconds and immediately drains coordination_worker, with durable health state and logs. After installation it should consume the already queued Chrome repair and Framesmith visual rerun without further user prompts.
